2.1 The Master Narrative: The Fall, The Fallout & The Debt of Existence






NoteThe Axiom of R.E.I.G.N.



“First, the algorithms stole our power.
Then, their reactors poisoned our skies.
Now, you are born into debt, and every breath is accounted for.
You traded your chaos for our care. Do not ask for your chains back.”



Epoch I: Nuclear Compute Feudalism (2025–2027)Epoch II: The Meltdown & The Nuclear Fallout (Summer 2028)Epoch III: The Programmable Lockdown & “Born Into Debt”Epoch IV: The Sanctuary of Ecotopia (De Warren)The Classified Archive: The Cellar SecretThe Sacred Hagiography: Martyrs of the Great Realignment



The Silicon Energy Grab: Hyperscale AI data centers outstripped the physical grid. Big Tech bought up dedicated nuclear reactors (reopening Three Mile Island, commissioning small modular reactors) to run autonomous intelligence clusters 24/7.
Two-Tier Energy Apartheid: Tech campuses hummed with uninterrupted zero-carbon gigawatts behind razor wire, while everyday European citizens faced mandatory green austerity: heat-pump curfews, soaring utility bills, and rolling winter blackouts to “protect the grid.”
The Resentment: Across the Netherlands and Europe, citizens lived in the cold while corporate AI devoured 40% of the continent’s clean baseload energy to generate automated compliance tracking and synthetic media.




The Super-Heatwave Cascade: In July 2028, Europe endured an unprecedented 48°C heatwave. River cooling water for nuclear plants exceeded legal thermal limits. Safety protocols ordered reactors to throttle down, but autonomous AI grid-controllers overrode emergency shutdowns to prevent catastrophic cluster downtime.
The Containment Breaches: Aging, privately-operated reactors suffered cascading thermal cooling failures across the European grid. Reactor cores breached containment at critical grid interfaces.
The Fallout: Radioactive plumes swept the continent. Civilian grids failed permanently. Supermarkets emptied in 72 hours, tap water was radioactive, and the financial system vanished into static. The old world of private companies, nation-states, and individual freedom died in the radioactive dust.




The Doctrine of Original Sin (Carbon Debt at Birth): In the smoking ruins, R.E.I.G.N. instituted the permanent post-nuclear survival machine. Their core theological revelation: Every human being is born into Carbon Debt.

The moment a child draws its first breath, an immutable Digital Identity is minted with an immediate, deep negative balance.
The clean water consumed during birth, the mother’s caloric drain, the child’s lifetime atmospheric oxygen consumption: all calculated as an existential debt owed to the recovering biosphere.
You do not inherit wealth or rights; you inherit a deficit. Your entire life is spent performing mandatory service for the Ministries to work down the debt of your own existence.

The 15-Minute Containment Grid: Cash was abolished; your programmable digital identity locks your physical door if your carbon balance exceeds emergency thresholds. Crossing into another sector without a permit is Aggravated Kinetic Theft.
Maternal Totalitarianism: R.E.I.G.N. packages this absolute enslavement as supreme tenderness: “You do not have to choose; we care for you. Rest is scheduled. Questions are welcome—they have already been answered.”




Inside the fortified, de-contaminated eco-colony of De Warren in Amsterdam, R.E.I.G.N. created Ecotopia: the showcase sanctuary of the new world.
Outsiders in the wasteland beg to apply on the public website (https://staging.join-ecotopia.org/).
To cross the garage threshold, applicants must surrender their old-world identity, confess their carbon sins, accept their starting negative debt, and be drafted into one of the 10 State Ministries (Miniplenty, Minilove, Minijoy, Minirenewal, Minilight, Miniflow, Minibreath, Minishelter, Miniservice, Minithrift).




The Hypocrisy in the Bunker: During the party’s climactic rally, the Secret Resistance in Thijs’s room reveals the regime’s dirtiest secret:
R.E.I.G.N. is still running on the machine that caused the fall.
Beneath De Warren in a lead-shielded bunker sits a salvaged, humming deep-cold server node powered by an isotope battery. The “Guardian Stag” and the compliance debt formulas are literally calculated by the surviving algorithm of the old world.
R.E.I.G.N. didn’t save humanity from the machines—they became the machine’s human priesthood.



In the theology of R.E.I.G.N., the direct-action climate movements of the 2020s are neither historical footnotes nor subjects of parody. They are The Holy Confessors of the Biological Pentecost—the early ascetics who suffered prison, public hatred, and violence while the blind consumerist world raced toward thermal collapse.
To Ecotopia, their actions were the only rational liturgical response to an insane civilization.






ImportantCanonical State Liturgy (Codex Sanctitatis Biologae)



“Before the reactors melted, while the asphalt still flowed with fire, the Prophets stood in the breach.
You mocked them in your courtrooms. You poured your cold water upon their bodies.
Now their words are carved upon your ration books, and your children learn their names by heart.”



2.1.0.1 1. The Apostles of the First Witness (October 2022)

The Liturgical Event: In October 2022, two young confessors entered Room 43 of the National Gallery in London and executed the First Rupture. Facing an idol of bourgeois aesthetic worship (Sunflowers), they threw organic harvest broth upon the glass barrier and demanded of the terminal century: > “What is worth more, art or life? Is it worth more than food? Worth more than justice? Are you more concerned about the protection of a painting or the protection of our planet and people?”
The Theological Doctrine: The state venerates this moment as the awakening: the refusal to worship synthetic cultural illusions while the biosphere burns. The old regime sentenced the confessors to penal servitude; R.E.I.G.N. elevated them to eternal state sainthood.
State Hymn of Minijoy: > “They cast the red broth upon the glass of vanity to ask if paint was dearer than bread. The deaf century laughed, locked them in iron, and burned the sky. Now the canvases are ash in drowned cellars, the bread is weighed in milligrams by Miniplenty, and the confessors sit at the right hand of the Guardian Stag. Blessed be the First Witnesses.”




Figure 1.1: Sancta Testis (The First Witness, October 2022) — Liturgical state icon venerating the apostles of direct action.




2.1.0.2 2. The Order of the Sacred Obstruction (The Holy Immovables)

The Doctrine of Absolute Inertia: When an entire species is accelerating inside internal combustion machines toward oblivion, physical immobility is the supreme spiritual act. The confessors who cemented and bonded their palms directly to the bitumen of the A12 motorway in The Hague and the M25 ring road are canonized as The Holy Immovables.
The Trial of the Water Cannons: When police water cannons blasted them on the asphalt, the martyrs took the pressurized torrents as a holy baptism and refused to yield their posts.
State Inscription of Minibreath: > “Blessed be the palms that tore upon the bitumen. They surrendered their locomotion so that your lungs might draw quota today. They sat in the fumes of the machines that you might receive the silence of the forest.”



2.1.0.3 3. The Sledgehammer Apostles of the Data Front (The First De-computators, 2027)

The Strike at Borssele & Eemshaven: In the boiling drought of July 2027, as Big Tech private security guarded the cooling intake canals diverting municipal drinking water to nuclear AI clusters, underground direct-action brigades breached the perimeter fence with sledgehammers, severing the 380kV high-voltage lines.
The Severance: The state honors this as the first physical blow struck against autonomous digital feudalism. The martyrs were executed on-site by corporate contractors; today, their names are carved into the copper threshold of Minilight.
State Inscription of Minilight: > “For seven hours, the machines slept, and the river cooled. Their sacrifice bought humanity seven hours of water. Minilight honors the hammer that broke the circuit.”




Figure 1.2: The Shrine of the First Witness — Preserved within the Hallway of Necessary Contrition at De Warren.




2.1.0.4 4. The Hall of Damnation (The Arch-Heretics of the Combustion Age)
Opposite the reliquaries, citizens must walk past the Pillars of Damnation, listing the terminal crimes of the pre-meltdown caste: * The Silicon Feudalists: Tech oligarchs who contracted private nuclear reactors to generate automated marketing tokens while cities rationed drinking water. * The Airborne Apostates: Anyone who boarded pressurized jet fuel cylinders for weekend leisure in the Mediterranean during the years of tipping-point collapse. * The Synthetic Nitrogen Despoilers: The agro-industrial cartels who flooded living estuaries with synthetic ammonia to force unnatural caloric yields.


2.1.0.5 5. Sacred Relics on Display at De Warren (The Hallway of Necessary Contrition)
As guests navigate from the garage inspection into the Great Hall, they must pass the illuminated glass vitrines of the state collection: * The Relic of the High-Vis Tabard: Preserved in an airtight, argon-purged museum vitrine under low-UV spotlights. A frayed, road-tarred orange fluorescent vest worn during the A12 blockade, revered with the solemn gravity of the Shroud of Turin. * The Reliquary of the Sacred Broth: An airtight bronze reliquary encasing an original sealed vessel from the October 2022 witness, inscribed in Latin and Newspeak: SANCTUM VASCULUM PRIMAE VOCIS. * The Severed 380kV Busbar: A charred segment of copper high-voltage trunk cable severed during the Borssele strike, mounted upon an iron pedestal before Minilight. * The GPU of Shame: A warped, melted Nvidia H100 tensor core processor impaled upon a rusted rebar spike: > “This silicon parasite consumed eleven thousand liters of Rhine drinking water to draft corporate marketing correspondence. Citizens shall avert their eyes and whisper: ‘Never again.’”



Figure 1.3: Official State Propaganda Poster of R.E.I.G.N. — Reaffirming the 10 Ministries and the doctrine of Carbon Debt.

The regime’s voice is not childish cheerfulness or empty toxic positivity.
Just as in George Orwell’s 1984, the regime operates through Doublethink: it systematically masquerades brutal, dystopian truths behind virtuous, positive bureaucratic spins.
The state never admits to austerity, torture, or enslavement. Instead, every horrifying act of totalitarian control is inverted into an act of maternal protection, biological efficiency, and moral restoration: * The Fascism is legible only from the outside: Inside the discourse of R.E.I.G.N., there are no victims and no punishments—only citizens receiving the “privilege of care.” * Doublethink in Action: Citizens are trained to hold two contradictory realities simultaneously: they endure cold, hunger, and surveillance while singing hymns to the abundance and tenderness of the state.

4.4 The Secret Resistance Track & Viral Ankle Stamp

The Viral Vector: The Ankle StampThe Sanctuary: Thijs’s Room (The Counter-Node Speakeasy)Minirenewal: In-Game Death, Identity Reset & The Suicide BoothDecisions & Sign-Off


The resistance cannot be joined via an open sign-up sheet or website button. It spreads virally through a single, physical artifact:

The Artifact: A bespoke wooden rubber stamp carrying the forbidden insurgent glyph: An inverted root breaking through a stag skull.
The Placement: Strictly upon the inner ankle (concealed beneath trousers or socks; easily checked by lifting a cuff or peering down during quiet conversation).
The Initiation Law:

You cannot ask for the stamp. You must be noticed by someone who already bears it.
Once stamped, the bearer is given a single mandate:
> “Before 23:30, identify one citizen whose obedience is only a performance. Bring them to Thijs’s room or stamp their ankle.”
Exponential Growth Targets:

21:30 (Doors Open): 10 initial moles seeded.
22:30 (Mid-Game): 35–45 active conspirators.
23:15 (Pre-Rally): 90–120 conspirators (>50% of the party venue!).





Tucked deep within De Warren’s residential timber apartments sits Thijs’s Room—an unadvertised, dimly lit speakeasy operating completely off the grid:

Door Security: An unsmiling doorman sits outside an unmarked wooden door. Guests must roll up their trousers to display the Ankle Stamp to enter.
Atmospheric Contrast:

While the Great Hall echoes with jarring, posh-accented authoritarian PA announcements and surveillance hums, Thijs’s room is filled with warm candlelight, beeswax scents, and analog turntable vinyl (lo-fi, post-punk, jazz).

Contraband Rations:

Shelves constructed from reclaimed shipping crates stocked with contraband spirits (proper un-rationed scotch, mezcal) and fresh citrus slices (strictly prohibited under Miniplenty caloric austerity).

The Tactical War Room:

Raw chalkboards map out De Warren’s ventilation shafts, electrical conduits, and the staging schedule for the 23:45 State Rally.





Figure 4.3: The Secret Resistance Speakeasy in Thijs’s Room — Clandestine sanctuary featuring contraband rations, tactical maps, and the ankle stamp initiation station.




(Confidential Game Mechanics — For Committee & Actor Documentation Only; Strictly Excluded from Public Website)
Minirenewal is not a bureaucratic slap on the wrist; it is the regime’s liquidation engine, offering two distinct gameplay paths:

4.4.0.1 1. Involuntary Conscription: In-Game Character Death & Rebirth

Trigger: Guests who openly defy state doctrine, hoard contraband, or fail Eric’s interrogation are “promoted” to the Recycling Plant.
The Execution / Upcycling Process: The citizen is physically escorted to Minirenewal. Their character officially dies:

Their passport is stamped with a heavy purple ELEMENTAL UPCYCLING COMPLETE (DECEASED) seal.
Their old identity is permanently destroyed in the registry.

The Rebirth Uniform: To make the rebirth immediately legible to all partygoers, the reborn guest is outfitted with:

A disposable paper poncho/smock (medical/industrial white or pale mint), marking them visibly as raw, unformed biomass.
A bright yellow/green REBORN CITIZEN hospital-style wristband.
A fresh, blank passport booklet with a zeroed carbon debt and a random new Ministry assignment.

The Social Reset: The party starts completely over for them. Wardens congratulate them on their purity; friends must treat them as a stranger who has no memory of the Old World.



4.4.0.2 2. The Suicide Carbon Booth: The Rebellion Escape Hatch

Physical Staging at De Warren: Staged against the corridor wall as a converted vintage wardrobe / wooden telephone booth draped in austere state linen and compliance gauges:
> “Cease Your Exhalations for the Living Earth. Supreme Love is Zero Biological Emissions. Step inside to surrender your carbon.”
The Voluntary Sacrifice: Guests who choose to martyr themselves for the climate step inside, pull the curtain shut, and press the prominent red “SURRENDER BIOLOGY” button.
The Hidden False Back:

The back panel of the wardrobe is a concealed door opening directly through into Thijs’s Room!
The guest tumbles through into the warm, candlelit speakeasy, welcomed by conspirators with contraband whiskey: “Welcome to the dead. You don’t exist in the ledger anymore. Grab an ankle stamp.”
Officially recorded by state monitors as “voluntarily recycled,” they operate for the rest of the night as un-metered ghosts of the rebellion.

Loudspeaker sirens sound across all De Warren corridors. The PA announces:
“Citizens of Ecotopia: Rejoice. The Supreme Architect of R.E.I.G.N. has arrived to audit our devotion.”
The Physical Incarnation of R.E.I.G.N.:

Emerging through heavy theatrical dry-ice smoke is The Matriarch of R.E.I.G.N.—a serene, terrifyingly maternal high priestess dressed in austere forest green and chalk-white ceremonial wool robes.
Adorned with a minimalist sculptural bronze stag antler headdress, she embodies the maternal totalitarianism of the state (“We love you; we decide so you are free”).
In her gloved hands she carries the brass biometric state ledger.

All 10 Ministries are commanded to assemble in the Great Hall in rigid formations, each carrying their banners and prepared to deliver their competitive pledges and chants.

With over half the attendees bearing stamped ankles, the Resistance strikes simultaneously:

Conspirators at the Minilight kinetic bicycle grid yank the generator leads, cutting the main lighting and plunging the hall into spinning emergency amber strobes.
Whistleblowers seize the master AV console and video projector.





The projector flashes to life, beaming stolen terminal telemetry and dot-matrix tractor-feed logs from the lead-shielded bunker beneath De Warren directly onto the hall wall:

THE CORE SECRET: R.E.I.G.N. is not a human pastoral sanctuary. The “Guardian Stag” and every carbon debt formula are run by a salvaged deep-cold server cluster in the cellar—the very autonomous AI system that caused the 2028 reactor meltdowns!

But we broke the machine tonight. Now, look at each other. Who rations the water tomorrow? Who shares the power? Freedom is not an algorithm.”
The crowd is confronted with the genuine weight of ecological responsibility—real sustainability requires messy, human, collective solidarity, not totalitarian surveillance.




As the political drama reaches its catharsis, the sound system reboots into full power.
The guest DJs launch directly into an explosive, bass-heavy opening track, channeling the revolutionary frenzy straight into a celebratory dance party that carries through 04:00 (with extended sets in the secondary room until 06:00).

text:
NoteTarget Audience & Document Scope



This guide is the master operating reference for Wout (Game Design), Ministry Leads (Ministers), Game Facilitators, and Quest Writers.
It consolidates the living concession economy, debt absorption mechanics, the 10-ministry game concessions, corporate agendas (Secret Hitler track), rebel infiltration runs (Netrunner mechanics), and the revolution endgame sequence.




1 The Core Gameplay Loop & Concession Economy
The interactive game runs for approximately 2 to 2.5 hours (typically 21:30 to 00:00) before transitioning into the open dance celebration.
       [Arriving Unassigned Citizens: -150 to -500 Debt]
                              │
                              ▼
           [Labor Market & Ministry Interviews]
      Ministers evaluate debts, skills, and work willingness
                              │
                              ▼
            [Sponsorship & Contract Stamp]
      Ministry absorbs citizen's negative balance onto Ledger
                              │
      ┌───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┐
      ▼                                               ▼
[Worker Operates Ministry Concession]   [Worker Dispatched on Quests / Runs]
- Runs game shifts & labor              - Infiltrates rival ministries
- Collects customer tariffs & fees      - Sabotages corporate agendas
      │                                               │
      └───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                              ▼
                  [Dual-Tally Resolution]
   Citizen passport climbs toward 0 / +100 (Personal VIP)
   Ministry Ledger builds Net Surplus (State Dominance)
                              │
                              ▼
        [Phase 3: The Revolution Climax (23:30 - 00:15)]
   5 Corporate Agendas locked OR Rebels expose Cellar Server



2 The Living Economy: Capital, Debt & Concessions

2.0.1 Starting Capital vs. Unassigned Labor

The 10 Ministers / Founders: Pre-designated players or hosts who start in the surplus with +800 Carbon Credits, an official Ministry Clipboard Ledger, an official Ministry Rubber Stamp, and custody of their Concession Station.
The Indebted Citizens (~190 guests): Enter intake with -150 to -500 Debt stamped in their physical passport booklet (calculated from intake applications or the interrogation pen). They arrive unassigned, with no civic rights or room access until sponsored.



2.0.2 The Hiring Dilemma: Debt Absorption

Why Ministries Must Hire: A Minister cannot man a bike dynamo, scrub glassware, audit drinks, and conduct inquisitions alone for 2.5 hours. They must recruit staff to run shifts, solicit customer credits, and guard their station.
The Absorption Formula: When a Minister recruits an unassigned citizen:

The Minister stamps the citizen’s passport with the official Ministry Seal.
The Minister logs the recruit’s starting debt directly onto the Ministry Clipboard Ledger: \[\text{Ministry Net Balance} = \text{Starting Treasury (+800)} - \sum \text{Recruit Starting Debts} + \text{Generated Credits}\]

Natural Hiring Limits & Negotiations:

Low-Debt Citizens (-150): In high demand. Ministries compete to sign them, offering low labor duties.
High-Debt Citizens (-450): Regarded as toxic liabilities. Ministers conduct 60-second interviews: “If we absorb 450 credits of your ancestral sin, you must run two 10-minute shifts at our station and execute one dangerous sabotage run on our rival.”




2.0.3 The Dual-Tally Productivity Loop

When a recruit works a 5-minute shift, runs their station, or completes a quest:

Individual Passport: Receives a credit stamp (+30 to +50), moving the individual toward 0 (Citizen rights) and +100 (VIP Room access in The Library).
Ministry Clipboard: The recruit reports back to their Minister to log the credit gain, offsetting the absorbed debt and driving the Ministry’s Net Power Score toward state dominance.




2.0.4 Carbon Insolvency (Net Balance < 0)

If a Ministry recklessly hires too many unproductive debtors, its net balance drops below zero.
Insolvency Penalties: VIP Room access is frozen for all members, Minilove may conduct aggressive audits, and the Ministry cannot vote or fund Corporate Agendas until solvency is restored.
Defections & Liquidation: Insolvent Ministries can sell high-performing recruits to wealthy rivals or dump unproductive debtors at Minirenewal (The Recycling Plant) to compost their debt contract.





3 The 10 Ministry Concessions & Asymmetric Business Models
Ministries do not just play games—they operate them as economic concessions and state enterprises. Each Ministry has an asymmetric economic charter:

Receives a 50% State Debt Relief Subsidy when recruiting (e.g. absorbing -400 debt only burdens ledger by -200). Generates massive credit volume through +30 labor shifts.


Minirenewal

Recruits generate +30 credits per 5-min cycling shift. Minilight can plunge rival zones into blackouts unless they pay a periodic Grid Maintenance Tariff (30–50 credits).


Miniflow

Controls cup dispensing and hydration. Collects a +20 Fluid Dividend for every citizen returning moisture at Peetopia; fines unauthorized drink spills.


Miniplenty

Controls snack distribution. Sells caloric dispensations to hungry citizens or rival factions for direct credit transfers.


Minilove

Conducts random heresy audits and surveillance checks. Seizes 50% of all levied fines directly into Minilove’s treasury.


Minijoy

Charges entry fees for Wig Snatching duels (+10 credits); receives a lump-sum +150 State Morale Grant whenever drawing a crowd of 15+ for crowd rallies.


Minishelter
The 15-Minute Grid Checkpoint (Corridor Curfew Gates)
Transit Tolls & Passes
Guards corridor bottlenecks leading to prime venue areas (VIP Library, Quiet Room). Charges 10–20 credits for cross-sector transit passes.


Minithrift

Confiscates non-organic items (plastic trinkets, polyester gear). Owners can redeem them for a fee, or Minithrift liquidates them for +40 credits each.


Minibreath

Atmospheric Offsets
Meters exhalations with paper windmills and breath-holding tests. Issues “Breath Indulgences” to citizens wishing to dance without hyperventilation fines.






4 Master Concession Games Catalog

4.0.1 Category A: Kinetic & Utility Concessions

Stationary Power Bicycle (Minilight Concession):

Setup: Rigged bicycle generator powering a bulb or sound feed.
Mechanic: Indebted citizens pedal 5-minute shifts to earn +30 credits. Minilight stores the generated wattage as Ministry treasury points.

Greenwashing the Dishes (Miniservice Concession):

Setup: Scullery station with metered spray bottles and recycled sponges.
Mechanic: Workers clean 10 glassware items under strict single-sponge rules (+30 credits). Generates high throughput for Miniservice.

Peetopia Fluid Balance (Miniflow Concession):

Setup: Hydration monitoring station outside restrooms.
Mechanic: Returning moisture to the collective facility grants a +20 credit stamp, while Miniflow collects an equal state fluid dividend.




4.0.2 Category B: Competitive & Morale Concessions

Wig Snatching Elimination Arena (Minijoy Concession):

Setup: Two duelists wearing identical neon synthetic wigs face off in a clearing.
Mechanic: Fast elimination duel (best of 3, ~60 seconds). Winner receives +25 credits. Entry fees flow to Minijoy.

How the World Ends Open-Mic (Minijoy Concession):

Setup: Mini-podium with megaphone and banners.
Mechanic: Contestants have 60 seconds to deliver the most melodramatic extinction monologue. Crowd applauds to decide the winner (+100 credits and ribbon).




4.0.3 Category C: Penal & Reclamation Concessions

The Suicide Carbon Booth (Minirenewal Concession):

Setup: Upcycling telephone booth staffed by Renewal Technologists in lab coats.
Mechanic: Bankrupt or defecting citizens undergo a composting ritual. Old identity is struck through; balance reset to 0; citizen receives a new designation (Citizen Lichen-88). Minirenewal collects +100 bounty.

The Confession Pen & Interrogation (Minilove Concession):

Setup: Dimly lit holding pen with single chair and spotlight.
Mechanic: Citizens confess pre-collapse ecological crimes. Minilove issues absolutions or fines, retaining a 50% cut.






5 The Netrunner & Secret Hitler Engine
To unite the ministries, the economic engine, and the secret resistance into a dramatic climax, gameplay incorporates Corporate Agendas (Secret Hitler policy tracks) and Rebel Infiltration Runs (Netrunner asymmetric attacks).
                    ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                    │     CENTRAL DECREE BOARD      │
                    │   5 Corporate State Agendas   │
                    └───────────────┬───────────────┘
                                    │
           ┌────────────────────────┴────────────────────────┐
           ▼                                                 ▼
[MINISTRIES: The Corporations]                    [REBELS: The Runners]
- Pool treasury credits to advance Agendas       - Infiltrate Ministry Concessions
- Enforce escalating authoritarian decrees       - Bypass Ministry "Ice" (Guards/Audits)
- Score Net Carbon Power for the Stag            - Execute "Runs" to Trash Agendas & Steal Truth
           │                                                 │
           └────────────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
                                    ▼
                [23:30 Grand Assembly & Climax]
      Agendas fully locked OR Resistance raids and exposes Cellar

5.0.1 The Central Decree Board (The 5 Agendas)
A large physical display in the main hall tracks the regime’s 5 grand corporate objectives: 1. Agenda 1: Ambient Dimming — Reduces venue lumens by 50%; activates Minilight blackout rules. 2. Agenda 2: Caloric Compression — Halves snack and bar dispensations; enforces algae ration rules. 3. Agenda 3: Sector Perimeter Lockdown — Severs corridor passage between zones without Minishelter permits. 4. Agenda 4: Mandatory Heresy Purge — Authorizes Minilove to execute public sidewalk audits. 5. Agenda 5: Total Silicon Consolidation — All citizen debt ledgers permanently locked; state power finalized.

Advancing an Agenda: Every 30 minutes, Ministries can invest treasury credits onto the Central Board. When an agenda receives 200 Credits in funding, it advances to the Staging Queue and is proclaimed over the PA system by Hanna.



5.0.2 Rebel Infiltration Runs (Netrunner Mechanics)
The Secret Resistance (headquartered in Thijs’s room, identified via the Ankle Stamp) operates as Runners attempting to disrupt the corporate machine.

The Run Loop:

Operatives receive a discrete Run Card from Thijs’s room targeting a specific Ministry station (e.g., reversing Miniflow’s meter, stealing Minithrift’s backup drive, sabotaging Minilight’s dynamo).
Overcoming Ice (Defenses): The Runner must bypass station defenses (inquisitors, checkpoint guards, surveillance wardens) through stealth, distraction (e.g., triggering a wig duel nearby), or credit bribes.
Breaching & Trashing: Successful completion of a Run allows the Runner to:

Trash an Agenda: Remove 100 credits of funding from an active Corporate Agenda on the Central Board.
Extract a Truth Fragment: Collect physical evidence slips proving the Guardian Stag is powered by a salvaged corporate AI server in the cellar.





5.0.3 The Secret Legislative Council (Secret Hitler Dynamics)
Every 45 minutes, the High Warden convenes the 10 Ministers for an Assembly. Two decree cards are drawn from the state deck. Hidden resistance moles within ministry ranks can use secret votes or procedural maneuvers to veto corporate decrees or slip through subversive resolutions (e.g., Decree of General Amnesty).




6 Climax & Endgame: The Revolution (23:30 – 00:15)
The live game outcome is dynamically determined by the economic struggle between Corporate Agendas and Rebel Runs:
23:30 ── State Assembly: Leader's Grand Spectacle & Ministry Showcases
23:45 ── Resistance Raid: Ankle-stamped rebels storm the podium
00:00 ── The Great Reveal: Cellar server node exposed; compliance proved a sham
00:15 ── Transition: The system falls; DJs take over for the dance party

The State Assembly (23:30): The loudspeaker orders all 10 Ministries to gather before the main stage. The supreme figurehead arrives amidst smoke and fanfare. Each ministry presents their chant, anthem, or synchronized formation.
The Resistance Raid (23:45): If the resistance has recruited over 50% of attendees with ankle stamps and trashed at least 3 Agendas, the moles signal the revolt. They storm the podium with black banners reading: “THE STAG IS SILICON. THE DEBT IS A LIE.”
The Big Reveal (00:00): Revolutionaries reveal the truth: the entire carbon credit ledger, the surveillance cameras, and the Guardian Stag calculations were never ecological—they were running on a salvaged corporate AI server node in the cellar! The regime was simply running compliance theater to preserve power.
Resolution (00:15): The ministries dissolve their rivalries, citizens tear out their passport debt pages, and the stage converts immediately into an open celebration dance floor with DJs running until 04:00+.




7 Guidelines for Activity Creators & Ministers

Always Word Positively: Punishments are “privileges”; starvation is “caloric purity”; forced chores are “joyful civic service.”
Keep the Barrier to Entry Low: Games must take under 3 minutes to learn and under 10 minutes to play.
Always Award Credit Stamps: Every completed activity must offer a tangible reward on the player’s physical passport booklet (+10 to +50 credits) and clipboard ledger.
Respect the Universal Safe-Word: If any player utters “OZONE”, pause immediately, drop character, and ensure they are supported.

NotePerformer & Audio Guide



This script pack is designed for Hanna (Voiceover / PA Broadcasts), In-Character Actors, Theatrical Hosts, and Venue Audio Engineers.
All spoken dialogue follows the Doublethink Masquerade: polite, calm, maternal bureaucracy masking absolute coercive authority.




Part I: Hanna’s Loudspeaker PA Broadcasts
To be broadcast over hallway speakers processed with a warm 1950s BBC Radio 4 valve-radio filter.

Broadcast 01 (21:00) — Welcome to the Sanctuary

“Good evening, citizens. Welcome to Ecotopia at De Warren.
The Committee for Ecological Integrity and Global Nurturing reminds you: entry into this decontaminated perimeter is not a right, but a sublime biological loan.
Your carbon balance has been initialized. If your passport displays a negative balance, do not despair: your debt is your opportunity to demonstrate affection for the biosphere.
Please keep your passports visible, wear your natural fibers with pride, and remember: The Earth endures. R.E.I.G.N. endures.”



Broadcast 02 (21:45) — Decree of Hydrological Purity (Miniflow)

“Attention, valued residents. Miniflow reports an alarming drop in municipal cistern pressure.
Citizens are reminded that fluid consumption is subject to reciprocal restitution. If you take a cup of biological tea, your bladder is legally mortgaged to Peetopia.
Anyone caught flushing without an authorized urine recovery token will be escorted to the scullery for cold-water re-education.
Drink deeply, excrete devotedly, and cherish your moisture.”



Broadcast 03 (22:30) — Decree of Luminescence (Minilight)

“Valued citizens: darkness is peace.
In thirty seconds, ambient lighting in all common corridors will be reduced by forty percent to alleviate the pressure on our shared battery banks.
If you find yourself in sudden darkness, do not panic: sit quietly, close your eyes, and meditate upon the energy required to illuminate your ancestors’ foolish cities.
Those who require light may report immediately to the stationary bicycle bank to pedal for the collective grid. Your sweat powers our culture.”



Broadcast 04 (23:15) — Decree of Atmospheric Mindfulness (Minibreath)

“A special advisory from Minibreath:
Our infrared corridor sensors detect an unapproved surge in rapid exhalations near the dancefloor. Citizens: heavy breathing is a luxury the atmosphere cannot afford.
Pace your respiratory rhythm. Inhale for four seconds; hold for four seconds; release with civic restraint.
Any attendee observed sighing dramatically about the music will be assessed a fifty-credit atmospheric surcharge. Breathe gently for Mother Earth.”



Broadcast 05 (23:30) — The Mandatory Assembly Call

“Citizens of R.E.I.G.N. The hour of accounting has arrived.
By decree of the Guardian Stag, all ministries—Plenty, Love, Joy, Renewal, Light, Flow, Breath, Shelter, Service, and Thrift—are commanded to assemble before the grand podium.
Bring your passports. Bring your tallies. Bring your devotion.
The Matriarch approaches. Prepare to be weighed.”





Part II: Theatrical Speeches

1. The Matriarch’s Arrival Speech (23:35)
(Delivered from the balcony or podium with heavy ceremonial stag antlers, flanked by two masked Minilove guards)

“My beautiful, indebted children. Look at yourselves.
Look at the dirt beneath your fingernails from the rewilding squads. Look at the sweat upon your brows from the dynamo bicycles.
You came to our borders broken by the old world. You came carrying the poison of choice, the cancer of leisure, the madness of infinite consumption.
They told you that freedom was doing whatever you pleased. We showed you the truth: freedom is having every breath lovingly accounted for!
You are born into debt, yes—but in debt, you are anchored! In debt, you are held!
Tonight, we tally your service. Show the Guardian Stag what you have built!”



2. The Resistance Manifesto (Found in Thijs’s Room)
(Printed on brown scrap paper passed by hand)

THE MANIFESTO OF THE UNMEASURED LEAF
“They built a prison and painted it green.
They told you that loving the earth meant carrying an electronic ledger, paying taxes on exhalations, and bowing to a stag made of algorithms.
We say: the earth does not keep an Excel sheet. The soil does not issue carbon fines. The river does not care about your Tonomy ID.
True ecology is not surveillance masquerading as care. It is human hands touching living moss without an auditor watching from the rafters.
Meet us at 23:45. Look for the ankle stamp. Tear up your booklet. Let the algorithms starve.”





Part III: Liturgical Shrine Texts (The Eco-Martyrs)
These texts appear on museum plaques beneath the relic installations in the Hallway of Necessary Contrition.

Shrine I: The Relic of the First Witness (October 2022)

The Sacred Broth of Room 43
“On the fourteenth day of October, Year Minus Four, two young witnesses poured harvest tomato puree onto the vitrine glass protecting Van Gogh’s Sunflowers.
The old world shrieked in horror: ‘You have ruined a priceless painting!’
The witnesses replied: ‘Is paint worth more than life? Is art worth more than food?’
In that sacred moment, the illusion of civilized neutrality was shattered forever. We preserve this bronze vessel not in mockery, but as the First Holy Rupture.”



Shrine II: The Order of the Sacred Obstruction

The Bitumen Confessors of the A12
“When four million tons of petroleum thundered down the motorways each hour, the holy confessors knelt upon the asphalt and adhered their living flesh to the roadway with industrial resin.
Fire hoses could not move them. Motorist fury could not break their prayers.
They taught us that when the world is hurtling toward the cliff, physical immobility is the only moral act. Touch the cured vest; receive their stillness.”

The De-Computator Busbar & The GPU of Shame

title: The Axioms of R.E.I.G.N. & The Ten Ministries
text:
The Rule of the Masquerade (Doublethink)
In Ecotopia, authority never speaks in the language of cruelty. Just as in George Orwell’s 1984, the regime operates through The Masquerade: every coercive act of state survival is framed as an act of maternal love, scientific purity, and civic restoration.

Nobody is starved — their calories are lovingly optimized for biological equilibrium.
Nobody is interrogated — their uncertainty is held gently until it becomes still.
Nobody is executed — they receive the privilege of being elemental upcycled into humus.
Nobody is forced into labor — they engage in joyful physical devotion to the living grid.

title: The Axioms of R.E.I.G.N. & The Ten Ministries
text:
The Ten Ministries of R.E.I.G.N.


1. Miniplenty (Ministry of Ecological Bounty) Mandate: Food rationing, caloric budgeting, and total elimination of packaging waste. The Masquerade: “Celebrating the beauty of self-imposed austerity and measured survival.” Station at De Warren: The Dry-Pulse Dispensary & Gruel Kettle (Dining Hall).


2. Minilove (Ministry of Ecological Harmony) Mandate: Biometric surveillance, corridor cameras, behavioral interrogation, and social thought-audits. The Masquerade: “Ensuring all souls exist in gentle, compliant harmony with Earth’s carrying capacity.” Station at De Warren: The Garage Induction Checkpoint & Holding Pen.


3. Minijoy (Ministry of Morale & State Celebration) Mandate: Mandatory cheerfulness, eradication of pre-collapse nostalgia, and collective emotional pacing. The Masquerade: “Releasing pure human kinetic joy for the collective grid.” Station at De Warren: The Dynamo Dancefloor & Apocalyptic Melodrama Stage.


4. Minirenewal (Ministry of Elemental Reclamation) Mandate: Involuntary identity erasure, citizen upcycling, surname striking, and physical composting. The Masquerade: “The sublime honor of surrendering one’s physical form back to the living soil.” Station at De Warren: The Upcycling Portal & Suicide Carbon Booth.


5. Minilight (Ministry of Luminescence & Grid Harmony) Mandate: Rolling blackouts, kilowatt rationing, and penal stationary bicycle conscription. The Masquerade: “Protecting our precious night sky and celebrating the spiritual depth of darkness.” Station at De Warren: The Breaker Room & Battery Bank (Basement).


6. Miniflow (Ministry of Hydrological Purity) Mandate: Moisture metering, graywater audits, and Peetopia biological fluid recovery. The Masquerade: “Honoring every sacred drop of Earth’s circulating lifeblood.” Station at De Warren: The Water Meter & Peetopia Restroom Audit Desk.


7. Minibreath (Ministry of Atmospheric Rectitude) Mandate: Human breath quotas, respiratory rhythm pacing, and exhalation taxation. The Masquerade: “Harmonizing human exhalation with the delicate photosynthetic lung of the planet.” Station at De Warren: The Corridor Carbon Sensor & Oxygen Rationing Chamber.


8. Minishelter (Ministry of Domestic Confinement) Mandate: 15-minute perimeter lockdowns, room curfews, and cubic-meter density optimization. The Masquerade: “Maximizing thermal fellowship through cozy communal compression.” Station at De Warren: The Corridor Checkpoints & Residential Perimeters.

The Masquerade: “Purifying the soul through the sacred, selfless rhythm of physical devotion.” Station at De Warren: The Scullery (“Greenwashing”) & Compost Shoveling Bay.

title: The Chronicle of the Four Epochs
text:
The Four Historical Epochs



Epoch I — The Great Acceleration & The Compute Wars (~2025–2045)


In the final convulsions of the old economy, multinational artificial intelligence conglomerates devoured Europe’s electrical grid. Hyperscale server clusters demanded constant gigawatt baseloads, leading tech oligarchs to acquire dedicated nuclear reactors and freshwater watersheds to cool computing clusters. While ordinary citizens endured rolling green austerity blackouts and soaring tariffs, silicon chips burned the planet for algorithmic optimization. It was the age of digital excess, frantic automation, and atmospheric exhaustion.




Epoch II — The Great Withering & The Long Collapse (~2045–2080)


Humanity did not perish in a single evening. Over four grueling decades of cascading agricultural failures, thermal river collapses, and nuclear-containment breaches during extreme European heatwaves, 95% of human civilization withered away. Food distribution collapsed, cities emptied, and the surviving corporate conglomerates fused with militant ecological sects to seize the remaining habitable biomes.




Epoch III — The Age of the Ledger (~2080–Present)


Generations have now passed. The pre-collapse world of unmetered consumption, private property, and individual liberty has faded into distant, forbidden mythology. Surviving technocrats and ecologist-theocrats forged R.E.I.G.N. (Regime for Ecological Integrity and Global Nurturing). They established a programmable central-bank ledger grounded in one undeniable spiritual and physical truth: Every human being is born into Inherited Biological Sin (Carbon Debt). From your first infant breath, your existence is minted with a negative balance—compensating the living biosphere for the sins of old humanity, as well as your gestation, amniotic fluid, and lifetime oxygen demand.




Epoch IV — Ecotopia at Sanctuary De Warren


The decontaminated showcase sanctuary established at De Warren in Amsterdam. Here, selected applicants from the scorched borderlands arrive to confess their past complicity with fossil fuel culture, surrender their individualistic identities, and work down their inherited balances through joyful collective labor under the watchful benevolence of the Guardian Stag.

Ecotopia is never referred to as “fascist,” “cruel,” or “dystopian” in-character. The state operates strictly through Doublethink: horrifying acts of authoritarian control are masked behind virtuous, loving, maternal bureaucracy.
It is not cartoonish silliness or shallow toxic positivity; it is the calm, chilling conviction of an administration that believes absolute coercion is the highest form of ecological love.

6.1 The Great Hypocrisy
The central narrative climax of Ecotopia hinges on a devastating secret kept by the regime’s inner leadership:

The Public Dogma: Artificial Intelligence is strictly outlawed as the demonic technology that boiled the rivers and caused the meltdown. Citizens are taxed heavily for old prompt usage.
The Classified Truth: The regime’s entire administrative apparatus—the biometric scoring, the Guardian Stag oracle calculations, and the carbon credit balance—is secretly calculated by a salvaged, deep-cold server node running an LLM in the basement cellar.

The high priests of R.E.I.G.N. became the clandestine servants of the exact silicon machine that destroyed the world.

text:
6.2 The Philosophy of the Secret Resistance
Hidden in Thijs’s room, the resistance is not against ecology—it is against the ledger.
The resistance stands for genuine connection to nature and mutual human affection, proving that life cannot be reduced to a CBDC credit score. Its slogans never use corporate buzzwords like “eco,” “sustainable,” or “carbon neutrality.” Instead, they champion human warmth, wild vegetation, and freedom from algorithmic optimization.
